name: Kent
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Kent, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Kent, Ohio for 2026: the downtown Festival of Lights with Santa, carriage rides and a craft at the Marvin Kent Train Car.
lede: Kent starts its Christmas season with the downtown Festival of Lights, with Santa and Mrs. Claus, caroling and horse-drawn carriage rides.
celebrates: The Kent Area Chamber of Commerce calls the Festival of Lights the official start of the holiday season in downtown Kent, with Christmas lights, caroling, horse-drawn carriage rides and appearances from Santa and Mrs. Claus. The Central Portage Visitors Bureau adds hot cocoa, cookies, children's books, a craft at the Marvin Kent Train Car and letter writing to Santa at the Gazebo, with Santa and Mrs. Claus joining the Mayor to light up downtown at Hometown Bank Plaza. Carriage rides leave from The Loft after Santa arrives.
lastyear: A community calendar listing for 2025 described the Festival of Lights as running from 5 pm to 8:30 pm at Hometown Bank Plaza on November 29, 2025, with Santa and Mrs. Claus arriving by carriage at 5:30 pm on Franklin Avenue. In 2026 the Kent Area Chamber of Commerce lists it for Saturday, November 28 from 5 pm to 8:30 pm.
facts: Downtown Kent has a Marvin Kent Train Car, where the Festival of Lights craft takes place, according to the Central Portage Visitors Bureau. The visitors bureau also lists the Main Street Kent Cookie Walk on December 6, 2026, which is marked sold out.
trains: Kent's festival craft happens at the Marvin Kent Train Car, but we did not find a Christmas train ride in Kent itself. The Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs its North Pole Adventure from Rockside Station in Independence from November 13 to December 22, 2026, with 5:00 pm and 7:55 pm departures, a 90 minute ride and tickets listed at $60 to $110 per person, according to the railroad. Lake Metroparks Farmpark in Kirtland says its Holiday Ice and Lights Festival includes a North Pole Train Display from the Northern Ohio Garden Railroad Society.
train_links: The railroad that runs the North Pole Adventure Christmas train from Rockside Station in Independence.
traditions: Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive and join the Mayor to light up downtown Kent.
Horse-drawn carriage rides begin after Santa arrives and leave from The Loft.
Kids can write to Santa at the Gazebo.
A craft is offered at the Marvin Kent Train Car.
kidfact: At the Kent Festival of Lights, kids can write letters to Santa at the Gazebo and make a craft at a real train car.
faq: When is the Kent Festival of Lights 2026?
The Kent Area Chamber of Commerce lists it for Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 5 pm to 8:30 pm at Hometown Bank Plaza.
When does Santa arrive in downtown Kent?
Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive at 5:30 pm, according to the chamber and the visitors bureau.
Are there carriage rides in Kent?
Yes. The Central Portage Visitors Bureau says carriage rides begin after Santa's arrival and depart from The Loft.
The visitors bureau lists a craft at the Marvin Kent Train Car and letter writing to Santa at the Gazebo.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kent for 2026, and here is what he found: 1 family event, none of them listed as free. The magic starts on November 28 with the Festival of Lights in downtown Kent. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kent

  • 1 Christmas event for kids in Kent
  • Price not listed for the Festival of Lights
  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive at 5:30 pm at the Festival of Lights (November 28)
  • Tree and light shows: Festival of Lights with caroling and horse-drawn carriage rides (November 28)
  • Trains: a craft at the Marvin Kent Train Car during the festival; the nearest train ride is the North Pole Adventure on the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad from Rockside Station in Independence
  • Season: November 28

Planning a bigger day out? Kent families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Cleveland, which covers Wild Winter Lights at the Zoo, The Nutcracker, Holiday Concerts with the Cleveland Orchestra at Severance and Storytime with Santa.
